references.context: Module theory: product module indexed by arbitrary family, with coordinatewise operations
Module theory: natural tensor-product-to-product comparison induced by projections

references.disposition: Every indexed family is permitted; the map need not be surjective and the index set need not be countable.

review_rationale: Inspected the natural tensor-product comparison into a product of tensors, with injectivity required for every indexed family of R-modules. No surjectivity, countable index restriction, or flatness is asserted in this definition.
